tasks.title: Implement the guarded Windows operator foundation
acceptance: Create localpilot/operator.py with an OperationRisk enum containing READ_ONLY, REVERSIBLE, and DESTRUCTIVE
Create a CommandSpec dataclass that stores argv as a list of strings, the operation risk, and a timeout; do not accept shell command strings
Create a CommandRunner that invokes subprocess.run with the argv list and shell=False, captures stdout/stderr, applies the timeout, and returns a structured result
Destructive operations must be denied unless an explicit approval callback returns true; no approval callback means destructive operations are denied
Read-only and reversible operations may run through the same policy layer without destructive approval

Create tests/test_operator.py proving shell metacharacters remain literal arguments and cannot become a second command, destructive commands are refused without approval, and a harmless approved command can run
Keep this task to the operator foundation only; do not yet wire command execution into the main agent
Do not weaken the existing stable/developer/candidate separation or autonomous-editing path protections

tasks.title: Add deliberate pre-CI self-review and repair stages
acceptance: Review the candidate diff against acceptance criteria before push
Return concise engineering findings and a pass-or-repair verdict without hidden reasoning
If repair is required, edit only through CandidateTools and inspect the resulting diff
Re-run non-executing static checks after repair
Never auto-promote, never execute candidate code locally, and never weaken candidate confinement
Record reusable review lessons in the existing learning database

tasks.title: Add SQLite-backed machine knowledge and change history
acceptance: Store structured machine facts locally
Record observed changes with timestamps and sources
Never commit machine-private data to GitHub

tasks.title: Add a resumable idle self-development supervisor
acceptance: Pause promptly when user activity returns
Resume candidate work later
Never promote a candidate automatically

tasks.title: Add screenshot and foreground-window observation
acceptance: Keep capture local by default
Avoid continuous recording
Expose observation through explicit tools

tasks.title: Build a guarded local model adaptation and weight-improvement lab
acceptance: Keep the active base model immutable and train candidate adapters or weights separately
Build curated training and evaluation datasets only from explicitly approved non-secret LocalPilot outcomes
Start with LoRA or other parameter-efficient adaptation before attempting full-weight training
Benchmark every candidate against the current model on held-out coding, tool-use, safety, and regression tasks
Reject candidates that regress safety, reliability, or task performance
Require explicit human approval before changing the active developer or everyday model
Keep rollback artifacts and provenance for every promoted model candidate
Design later full-weight retraining as a separate hardware-gated stage rather than silently overwriting a running model
